target.definition: Seasonally adjusted annual rate of privately-owned housing starts in the United States for August 2026, as first reported by the Census Bureau/HUD Monthly New Residential Construction release.

inputs.name: recent_saar_level
inputs.description: Recent monthly SAAR level of private housing starts around mid-2026

provenance.rationale: Starts have hovered in the 1.2-1.5M SAAR range in recent years; mid-2026 likely near the middle of that band

inputs.name: annual_private_starts
inputs.description: Total private housing starts over the trailing year

provenance.rationale: Annual total consistent with recent SAAR levels

inputs.name: seasonal_factor_august
inputs.description: Ratio of August unadjusted starts to the annual average (August is a relatively strong month)

provenance.rationale: August typically slightly above the annual average for housing starts

inputs.name: single_family_share
inputs.description: Share of private starts that are single-family

provenance.rationale: Single-family has been roughly two-thirds of starts in recent years

inputs.name: multifamily_share
inputs.description: Share of private starts that are multifamily (2+ units)

provenance.rationale: Single-family starts have run around 0.9M SAAR recently
Multifamily starts have run around 0.4M SAAR recently

inputs.name: permits_to_starts_ratio
inputs.description: Ratio of housing starts to housing permits (starts tend to track permits)

provenance.rationale: Starts and permits are closely linked, with starts slightly below permits on average

inputs.name: august_permits_saar
inputs.description: Private housing permits SAAR around August 2026

provenance.rationale: Permits have run near 1.3-1.5M SAAR recently
Census household count is roughly 131-133 million in the mid-2020s

inputs.name: starts_per_household
inputs.description: Annual housing starts per household (formation plus replacement)

provenance.rationale: About 1.3-1.4M starts against ~132M households gives ~1% per year

paths.description: Start from recent SAAR level and apply a modest August adjustment
Sum single-family and multifamily SAAR components
Scale August permits by the starts-to-permits ratio
